details: Faithful long-horizon world-model rollouts need deep computation, but deeper fixed-depth models are costly to deploy and accumulate compounding prediction errors; depth is also allocated uniformly regardless of transition difficulty.

LoopWM: a looped-transformer world model in which a single parameter-shared transformer block (prelude / recurrent block / coda) is iterated T times to refine an action- and observation-conditioned latent state, making effective depth independent of parameter count.

Recurrent update h^(t+1) = A_bar h^(t) + B_bar e + R_bar(h^(t), e) with A_bar obtained by zero-order-hold discretization of a learnable negative-diagonal matrix, forcing all eigenvalues into (0,1) so latent dynamics stay contractive/bounded for any loop count or rollout length.

Two additional mechanisms: a learned sigmoid exit gate for adaptive per-transition loop depth at inference, and 'Deferred Decoding' — a decode-free K-step action-conditioned latent rollout with prediction heads invoked only at the terminal step (supervised by a terminal loss plus latent-consistency and contraction penalties).
Modules: observation encoder, action embedder, looped dynamics core, lightweight MLP heads for next observation, reward, and continuation.
Stochastic loop depth T ~ Poisson(mu_rec) sampled per sequence (rather than per micro-batch), with backprop through loops truncated at ceil(mu_rec/2).
Entropy regularization on the exit gate to prevent collapse to always/never exiting; layer-norm on the injected conditioning signal.
Terminal hidden state carried across environment steps (inner loop = latent refinement, outer loop = time); progressive curriculum increasing deferral horizon K from 1.
Text-based world modelling on ScienceWorld (14 task types: Boil, Chemistry, Conductivity, Melt, Power, etc.) and AlfWorld (clean, cool, heat, look, pick).

Protocol: feed five consecutive actions and score the resulting predicted world state; metrics are exact match, token F1, BLEU-4, and an entity score; per-step (Step 1-5) breakdowns are also reported.
An additional online/human evaluation on a 'danmaku generation' task, reported only as relative improvement figures.
LoopWM is ~1B parameters; baselines are closed/API LLMs: claude-opus-4-6-max, gemini-3-flash-preview-thinking, and qwen-3.5-flash.
Parameter-efficiency claim (up to 100x) is based on the size gap to the API baselines rather than a controlled depth-matched comparison.
No ablation isolating loop count / adaptive exit / spectral constraint; no reported FLOPs measurements (savings such as ~25x are illustrative estimates).
Continuous visual/control environments are only mentioned as loss being reducible, without reported results; no RL/policy-learning experiments.

key_findings.finding: A ~1B-parameter looped world model outperforms a much larger frontier LLM at text-based world-state prediction on ScienceWorld.
key_findings.evidence: Over 14 ScienceWorld task types with 5 consecutive actions, LoopWM reaches 68.4% EM / 85.3% token F1 / 80.7% BLEU-4 / 83.9% entity versus claude-opus-4-6-max at 47.2% / 72.8% / 64.4% / 72.3%; gemini-3-flash-preview-thinking gets 30.8% EM and qwen-3.5-flash 10.0% EM. Extreme case: Lifespan improves from 0% to 100% EM.

key_findings.finding: Deferred decoding (decode-free latent rollout with a single terminal decode) yields gains that grow with rollout length, indicating benefit from uninterrupted latent computation across steps.
key_findings.evidence: Relative EM improvement over gemini-3-flash rises from +73.2% at Step 1 to +103.6% (Step 3) and +113.8% (Step 5) averaged over tasks; LoopWM's own absolute F1/BLEU improve from 78.0/72.3 at Step 1 to ~87.5/82.0 at Step 3 while baseline per-step scores stay roughly flat (gemini 67.0-71.0 F1 across steps).

key_findings.finding: On AlfWorld the advantage is narrower and mixed, with entity prediction identified as the weak point.
key_findings.evidence: LoopWM overall 51.6% EM / 80.4% F1 / 71.6% BLEU / 81.1% entity: best BLEU of the four models and second on EM and F1 (claude 53.0% EM; gemini 50.0% EM, 83.5% F1, 90.2% entity), with entity scores consistently below both flash baselines across all five action categories.

key_findings.finding: The spectrally constrained state-retention parameterization gives boundedness of the looped latent dynamics by construction.
key_findings.evidence: Parameterizing A = diag(-exp(a)) and A_bar = exp(Delta A) forces all diagonal entries into (0,1), so rho(A_bar) < 1 holds throughout training without gradient clipping, post-hoc normalization, or tuning; the same bound is extended over K outer steps via a cumulative-contraction penalty.
